chapter: Sonny South breakup and small bands
title: Bocage brothers leave Sonny South, and the band reorganizes
summary: Eddie Pearson and the Bocage brothers are discussed. A dispute led to firings and a rival band, and Turner kept the original Sonny South going with new players.
